verdict.rationale: Docs show value lists (customer IDs, cards, IPs, emails) manageable via Dashboard and API (value_lists.md), plus custom Radar rules for blocking/allowing based on these attributes, satisfying most of the allow/block list requirement. However, velocity-limit rules are not explicitly documented, and community reports note Allow Rules aren't enabled by default and require contacting support to activate, plus limited programmatic override control for false positives — a real caveat to 'managed programmatically'. Missing for 10: explicit velocity-limit configuration docs, device-fingerprint list management, and confirmation that allow-list activation is self-service via API without support intervention.
